scientific_intent.scientific_task: Solve independent coupled tridiagonal systems using PCR, CR and Thomas/sweep strategies
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Parallel cyclic reduction, cyclic reduction with backward substitution, scalar/private/four-system sweeps, optional five-transpose data reordering
scientific_intent.numerical_risk: Elimination conditioning and roundoff, layout/endpoint indexing, invalid partial transpose tiles or partial vector batches; original checker only prints averaged error, new full oracle rejects independently
scientific_intent.validation_target: All45 complete batch solutions and defined physical workspaces/inputs/guards, exact Fraction solutions/elimination coefficients and per-system FP64 backward error
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Choose batched tridiagonal algorithms and data layouts for line solves in PDE/transport methods; these are controlled operator tests, not a full PDE prediction certificate
